politica.p1: In accordance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and its regulations, the customer authorizes the shop to collect, store, use and update their personal data (identification, contact details and vehicle data).
politica.p2: The data is used only to provide sales and maintenance services, keep each motorcycle's history, notify the status of their orders and send receipts and estimates.
politica.p3: The data owner may access, update, correct and request deletion of their data, and revoke this authorization at any time by asking at the shop.
politica.p4: If the customer doesn't authorize, they will still be served, but won't receive emails from the system.
